title: Circe
author: Madeline Miller
summary: The witch-goddess known from the Odyssey tells her own life: a lonely girl born to a minor god who is exiled to a remote island. There she learns herbs and magic, meets famous figures from Greek myth and becomes powerful.
readIf: you want a lyrical, feminist retelling of myth that is patient and richly drawn.
skipIf: you want fast plotting, since it unfolds across centuries with a slow, reflective pace.

pairings.reason: Same author, another heartfelt Greek myth retelling told with a gentler, more romantic focus.
Another atmospheric, beautifully written story with magic and a lyrical voice.
Another quiet, strange book about a solitary person learning the rules of a mythic place.
